articleTitle: A Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Channel Attention and Spatial Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Due to issues such as target occlusion and complex background interference, the accuracy and stability of target tracking still need to be improved. To address these issues, this paper proposes a target tracking algorithm based on channel attention and spatial attention. This algorithm applies channel attention and spatial attention mechanisms to the field of target tracking. Among them, the channel attention mechanism enhances the ability to extract target features by focusing on important channels in the input feature map; The spatial attention mechanism achieves accurate estimation of target position by focusing on important areas in the feature map, enhances the expression ability of target features by utilizing channel attention mechanism, and suppresses interference from background features by utilizing spatial attention mechanism. Through experimental verification on the got-10k dataset, the algorithm proposed in this paper has higher tracking accuracy and stability in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of Handwritten Mongolian Recognition System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Recently, the AlexNet network model has achieved excellent performance in image processing. However, this model is difficult to apply in the embedded field, because there are huge data parameters and complicated calculations. Therefore, we modified the AlexNet network to reduce the number of parameters to 18,532 and used the standard dataset MNIST to test the network, and the accuracy reached 97.57%. We have built a map library of Ordinal Numbers in Mongolian. By collecting script Mongolian word order numbers, image preprocessing, and classification, we completed the establishment of the Mongolian ordinal image library. The database test results show that the accuracy rate is 96.66%. Finally, we deploy the improved AlexNet network to the FPGA to the recognition system. System tests showed a correct rate of 95.62 percent, an identification speed 11.07 times higher than a PC system, and a system power consumption of 0.405W.

articleTitle: Ship Residuary Resistance Prediction Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Prediction of residuary resistance of ships at the initial design stage is of a great value for evaluating the ships performance and for estimating the required propulsive power. Essential inputs include the basic hull dimensions and the ship velocity. Ship residuary resistance prediction method based on Support Vector Machine is investigated. The 308 full-scale ships residuary resistance experiment data were used for training and prediction. The input parameters are longitudinal position of the center of buoyancy, prismatic coefficient, and length-displacement ratio beam-draught ratio, length-beam ratio and Froude number. The output parameter is residuary resistance per unit weight of displacement. The predicted results are compared with those of experiment data, by using mean square error and correlation coefficient to measure the prediction accuracy. And the good predictive ability performance is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-scene and Multi-terminal Joint Inspection Method of Substation Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The conventional multi-scene and multi-terminal joint inspection method of substation mainly focuses on inspection efficiency, and the inspection data of multiple terminals are complicated, so it is impossible to comprehensively monitor substation equipment. Therefore, a multi-scene and multi-terminal joint inspection method of substation based on machine vision is designed. Plan the multi-scene and multi-terminal joint inspection path of substation, make clear the inspection requirements of key equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers and cables in substation, and formulate corresponding inspection schemes according to different scenes and targets. Based on machine vision, the location of multi-scene inspection terminal in substation is calibrated, and a variety of sensors are mounted on the inspection robot, and the inspection image data collected by the sensors are integrated into a platform to realize unified management and scheduling of joint inspection and efficient inspection of substation scenes. By means of comparative experiments, it is verified that the inspection accuracy of this method is higher and it can be applied to real life.

articleTitle: A Design of Vibration Acceleration Signal Integrator Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Under the condition of vibration acceleration sensor only, if vibration speed or vibration displacement signal is to be obtained, the vibration acceleration signal must be integrated by hardware or software. In order to solve these problems, an FFT signal integrator based on the virtual instrument of Labview is designed. Through the simulation of the input analog vibration acceleration signal, the integration result of the integrator is compared with the theoretical value, which proves that the signal integrator is very reliable. The application of the integrator can reduce the input of hardware and save the cost.

articleTitle: Research on Radar Target Recognition Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Radar target recognition is the process of identifying the presence, position, size, type and other attributes of an object using radar echo signals. There are two main approaches for radar target recognition: statistical methods and feature-based methods. Statistical methods rely on techniques such as likelihood ratio test, track before detect and constant false alarm rate to analyze the signal characteristics. Feature-based methods employ machine learning methods such as deep learning to extract and classify the target features. Radar target recognition has various applications in domains such as autonomous driving, air traffic control and military reconnaissance. This article presents a comprehensive survey of the state-of-the-art, challenges, principles, methods and key technologies of radar target recognition, and discusses the future research directions.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Adjustment Algorithm for Intelligent Home Lighting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In order to address energy scarcity and provide high-quality lighting needs, a light brightness adaptive adjustment method based on fuzzy PID algorithm and optimization algorithm has been proposed. This method comprehensively considers factors such as indoor light source layout, sunlight distribution, and lighting sensor layout, and establishes corresponding constraint mathematical models with average illumination and uniformity as constraints. The experimental results show that the fuzzy PID method performs well in energy conservation, but the lighting quality is relatively poor; The optimization method is superior to the artificial neural network method in terms of energy consumption and lighting quality. Therefore, in intelligent indoor spaces, adopting adaptive lighting brightness adjustment methods based on fuzzy PID algorithm and optimization algorithm can effectively improve the efficiency of light utilization, enhance people's visual comfort, and reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Detection of Safety Helmet Wearing Method Based on SSD and Area Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: A new wearing helmet detection algorithm is proposed, which combines area ratio and SSD to detect whether the wearing helmet method is correct. The targets with the area ratio above 0.5% are detected by the algorithm. Experimental results show that when the area ratio is not less than 0.5%, the average recognition accuracy of the algorithm is 91.29% and the detection speed is approximately 85ms.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Construction for Automated Automotive Welding Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Welding robots are widely used in the automotive welding process, but the automated welding process data of automotive welding robots is huge and there are problems such as weak data relationships and lack of effective management, so this paper proposes a knowledge graph construction method for automated automotive welding process. Firstly, we analyze the automated welding process data, use the top-down construction method to construct the automated welding process ontology and build the ontology on Protégé to form the conceptual framework of automated welding process. Secondly, a rule-based knowledge extraction and transformation algorithm is proposed to automatically extract entities, attributes and relationships from automotive automated welding process data according to the mapping rules between automotive automated welding process ontology model and structured data. Finally, Neo4j is used to store entity relationships and their attributes to complete the construction of the welding process knowledge graph. The construction of automated automotive welding process knowledge graph provides a new way of knowledge organization and representation for automated automotive welding process, and provides support for intelligent research and application of automotive welding process.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Based Support Vector Machines in Motion Imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In order to improve the classification recognition rate, this paper carries out a theoretical analysis of the support vector machine (SVM), in order to find the optimal parameters C, g, the particle swarm algorithm optimized support vector machine (PSO-SVM) is introduced to carry out parameter optimization, and for the shortcomings of the PSO-SVM, the optimal classifier, i.e., Adaptive Particle Swarm Algorithm Optimized Support Vector Machine (APSO-SVM), is introduced and the extracted features are respectively inputted into the extracted features are fed into the optimal classifier APSO-SVM respectively. The final classification results show that the proposed feature fusion analysis and the introduced APSO-SVM can effectively classify MI EEG signals.

articleTitle: Research on machine vision decision-making system for self-driving logistics vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Aiming at the integrated problem of perception and decision-making of self-driving logistics vehicles in complex traffic environments, this study starts from four aspects: environment perception and cognition, scene understanding and analysis, intelligent decision-making and obstacle avoidance, and optimized path planning. Deep convolutional neural network models are utilized to extract, analyze and understand sensory data, and multi-sensor data fusion technology is used to integrate the information. Reinforcement learning methods are applied for the system to automatically learn decision-making strategies, while path planning algorithms are used to find the optimal driving path. In the simulation experiments of the machine vision decision-making system using Gazebo, the recognition accuracy reaches 98.2%. The results demonstrate the feasibility of the technical solution for an automated driving machine vision decision-making system.

articleTitle: Li-ion battery capacity prediction based on artificial intelligence for production line
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: A capacity prediction method is proposed for a production line to reduce the battery production cost, which can reduce the capacity measurement time by half. The artificial intelligence algorithm predicts the capacity based on the features extracted from the partial charge-discharge data. The neural network performs best among common algorithms due to its nonlinear fitting ability. The prediction error of the testing set is 0.19%. In addition, a multi-model parallel prediction method is proposed, which can effectively solve the problem of maximum error.

articleTitle: Field weakening speed expansion control of permanent magnet synchronous motors based on stochastic gradient descent
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In order to improve the rated speed of permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) and solve its lag problem of output voltage decline information in the weak magnetic region, this study proposed an algorithm of weak magnetic expansion speed control of PMSMS based on stochastic gradient descent. We analyze the principle of PMSMS steady-state operation, establish the PMSMS mathematical model, and carry out the coordinate transformation using static three-/two-phase method. On this basis, we put forward a method of weak magnetic expansion speed control for PMSMs, which overcomes its direction information delay of rated speed and output voltage. In addition, we conducted simulation experiments in Matlab/Simulink to test the performance of this algorithm by comparing with the maximum torque/current control method. The results demonstrated that this control method can improve the rated speed of PMSMs and overcome the problem of low control accuracy caused by the lag information of output voltage direction decline information in the weak magnetic region.

articleTitle: Research on multi-modal data fusion technology based on automotive spot welding process
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: With the wide application of automotive welding automation, the fusion of multimodal data has become an important research direction. In this paper, a multi-modal data fusion technology based on automotive spot welding process is proposed, including management configuration service, equipment data service, database data service, data fusion service, gateway service and public class module. Through the selection of microservice framework Spring Cloud, message queue, front-end framework, and other technologies, different types of data sources are accessed, managed, processed, and stored. Experimental results show that this technology can effectively improve the efficiency of data integration, sharing and application, and provides strong technical support for the intelligent construction of automotive welding automation.

articleTitle: Application Research of Digital Virtual Human Models Based on Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This research aims to create a virtual space with distinct Wuhan characteristics using a modular design approach, enhancing users’ sense of identification and emotional resonance with the virtual world in the metaverse. By focusing on interaction process design, user body scans data, and visual information collection for user modeling, we employ Kinect, temperature sensors, and pulse sensors for interactive design to improve the user experience. We adopt an interdisciplinary research framework centered around the user to explore effective ways for individuals to maximize their experience of diverse life within their finite lifespans. Through data collection, we decompose real user data and integrate Wuhan’s urban characteristics, creating versatile and relatively independent modules that expand the diversity and multiplicity of the virtual space.

articleTitle: Mechanical Cylindrical Part Surface Defect Detection of Components using YOLOv5 and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Effective part defect detection is vital in the manufacturing industry to ensure high-quality standards and minimize the impact of defective parts. Traditional methods lack objectivity and struggle to capture intricate defect patterns, while deep learning approaches face challenges in handling small-sized defects and fusing multi-scale features. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel part defect detection network that combines YOLOv5 with attention mechanisms. The network introduces a new backbone network (SKBnLrNet) and a neck network (SAConNet) to enhance feature representation and fusion. The experimental results prove the superiority of the network. The accuracy rate of 50 unqualified parts detection is 100%, and the accuracy rate of 50 qualified parts detection is 98%. This research is helpful to improve the detection level of parts defects.

articleTitle: Modeling optimization of distributed prefabricated manufacturing system based on iterative taboo search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Prefabricated component (PC) manufacturing enterprises usually adopt distributed scheduling to cope with large-volume component order production and to facilitate the reduction of distribution costs, thus a reasonable and scientific production strategy is conducive to component manufacturing enterprises in the limited capacity of the premise, to further improve the production profit. Therefore, the study proposes a new iterative taboo search algorithm for the distributed precast component flow shop order receiving and scheduling problem, with the goal of maximizing the net profit of the enterprise. The algorithm is based on the taboo search and uses a perturbation operation to jump out of the taboo local optimal solution, thus enabling the search of more solution space. articleTitle: Using lightweight YOLOv5 model on wearable devices for indoor natural gas work behavior recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This research focuses on leveraging the YOLOv5s lightweight model to achieve real-time recognition of indoor natural gas work behavior using wearable devices. The approach involves utilizing the YOLOv5s model to process video captured by wearable devices with cameras, detecting and tracking hands, gas leakage detectors, and scenes. Subsequently, the WIoU calculation method is employed to determine the temporal characteristics of containment relationships between different categories, thus ascertaining the completion of specific work actions. The model is trained and tested using a dataset collected through on-site experiments, and its recognition accuracy and real-time performance are evaluated. The experimental results demonstrate significant progress in indoor gas operation behavior recognition, achieving real-time and accurate identification of indoor gas operators’ behaviors.

articleTitle: Inter-Pose: An Interactive 3D Modeling Based on 6D Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: 3D modeling serves as a cornerstone in various domains such as XR, digital content, and interactive media, enabling users to simulate and perceive immersive 3D world. Traditional 3D modeling using CAD software often proves labor-intensive and detached from real-world scenarios. In response, we introduce Inter-Pose in this work, a novel interactive 3D modeling approach leveraging 6D pose estimation. It enables users to design 3D scenes interactively, akin to games like Minecraft, by predicting layouts based on 2D projections of 3D bounding box vertices. Users can arrange models in the real world, and corresponding scenes are presented on computers, overcoming challenges posed by conventional 3D modeling methods. We evaluate the end-to-end trainable 6D pose estimation module in Inter-Pose on the InterCube dataset, demonstrating its rapid and accurate performance. Operating at 63 fps on a GTX 1050ti GPU, Inter-Pose proves suitable for real-time applications. Our contributions include the development of an interactive modeling approach, a precise 6D pose estimation module, and the creation of the InterCube dataset.

articleTitle: A backstepping control strategy of variable mass quadrotor based on fault observe
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The quadrotor dynamics model is established based on Newton’s motion theorem, and the adaptive fault observer is designed for the actuator fault. The attitude ring is based on the integral backstepping sliding mode to accurately track the desired attitude. The position ring considers the mass change to compensate through the designed adaptive law, and the position is controlled based on the adaptive backstepping sliding mode to complete the position tracking. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Task-Oriented Robotic Grasping for Intelligent Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Grasping is the first step in many robotic manipulation tasks, and it is essential for applications of robots in intelligent manufacturing scenarios. Traditional grasp planning methods rely on force-closure analysis and fail to adapt for new objects quickly. Recent progress in computer vision and deep learning makes automatic grasping planning promising for unseen new objects. However, these grasp planning methods usually generate arbitrary grasp poses, and few has consider the problem of choosing the appropriate grasp pose for subsequent manipulation tasks. In this study, we propose a novel yet practical grasp mapping method Hand-to-Gripper (H2G). In H2G, a task-oriented semantic grasp strategy is introduced to meet the semantic constraints to make an action feasible. In the learning phase, it constructs a hand-object grasp relationship from both the estimation of the object pose and keypoints of the user’s hand. In the application phase, it repeats this user-specified task-oriented task. The proposed approach is evaluated on a UR-10e robot with a RealSense D435i RGB-D camera. The implemented system provides a low-cost solution for teaching robot task-oriented grasps in intelligent manufacturing scenarios.

articleTitle: End-to-End Delay Testing and Research on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: According to the principle of network time synchronization, the performance of network time synchronization relies on network transmission delay. Accurate measurement of end-to-end delay in the Internet plays an important role in improving network performance. Data transmission is susceptible to network conditions, and network delay can vary accordingly. In addition, clock deviations and clock frequency differences at both the sending and receiving ends can also affect network delay. To address these issues, this article proposes an end-to-end delay testing method based on time synchronization between the sending and receiving ends. Furthermore, a prediction model based on a backpropagation (BP) neural network is used to predict the end-to-end delay in the Internet. Through training and learning using this method, precise prediction of end-to-end delay can be achieved, laying the foundation for subsequent delay compensation. The feasibility of the algorithm is demonstrated through simulations.

articleTitle: Robot Dynamic Path Planning Based on Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Firefly algorithm has the advantages of simple principle and few parameters, but it still has some shortcomings such as slow convergence speed and poor accuracy, so this paper proposes an improved firefly algorithm for robot dynamic path planning method (IFA-DWA). Firstly, PWLCM chaotic mapping was used to initialize firefly population to solve the problem of uneven initial population distribution. Secondly, the dynamic adaptive step size strategy is proposed to balance global and local development capabilities. Then, the attraction between distant fireflies is enhanced to improve the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm. Finally, the improved sparrow search algorithm is integrated with the dynamic window method to enhance the robot’s ability to avoid unknown obstacles. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by matlab simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on an Improved Unsupervised Algorithm for Wood Image Stitching
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This study proposes a strategy based on pre-training and fine-tuning aimed at enhancing model performance and training speed. Initially, the model is pre-trained on natural images to learn a universal feature representation. Subsequently, it undergoes fine-tuning on a wood dataset to acquire specific characteristics of wood images. The network reconstruction phase is designed with dual branches: a low-resolution branch and a high-resolution branch. The low-resolution branch integrates a lightweight channel attention mechanism, autonomously learning the significance of each channel. The high-resolution branch leverages an enhanced self-attention mechanism to model the remote dependencies present in the input data. The reconstruction network incorporates multiple residual structures, effectively overcoming gradient vanishing and explosion challenges. Experimental results indicate that the proposed approach achieves a harmonious balance between computational efficiency and output quality, proving effective in the stitching of wood images.

articleTitle: Dual Contrastive Learning for Unpaired Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In real hazy conditions, the existing unpaired image dehazing by using cycle-consistency loss constraints and adversarial loss constraints effect is not enough for the network to be more effective for the acquisition of potential relationship between hazy images and clear images. In this paper, we propose an effective framework for unpaired image dehazing. Our approach improves the Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks (Cyclegan) by incorporating an improved Deep Residual Shrinkage Network in the generator, an attentional mechanism for the deep features to filter out the efficient subset as well as soft thresholding to remove the noise to further mine the potential feature distributions between the domains, introducing the contrast learning in self-supervised learning, double layer contrastive learning constrains deep feature relationships for better image dehazing and restoration. Extensive experiments show that we demonstrate superiority over existing unpaired dehazing methods on Nyu-depth and Reside datasets, and produce dehazing results comparable to several fully supervised dehazing methods.

articleTitle: Shallow machine learning fault diagnosis for industrial equipment based on vibration data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In order to improve the maintenance efficiency of industrial equipment and ensure its safe and stable operation, it is of great significance to carry out effective fault diagnosis of industrial equipment. The fault diagnosis by analyzing the vibration signal of industrial equipment has great feasibility and advantages. This paper firstly elucidates the significance of fault diagnosis based on vibration signals. Subsequently, it expounds on the current research status of shallow machine learning fault diagnosis in terms of signal noise reduction, feature extraction, and feature dimensionality reduction. The advantages and limitations of typical methods used in this technology are summarized, along with the identified issues that need to be addressed and future developmental directions.

articleTitle: Survey on Reliability Engineering for AI Software Systems: An Extension Based on the IEEE 1633 Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Software reliability stands as a cornerstone in the development and deployment of dependable applications, with the advent of AI intensifying its significance. The intricacies introduced by AI software demand tailored reliability frameworks, yet the existing research lacks a comprehensive engineering methodology for ensuring AI software reliability. This paper leverages the structural foundation provided by the IEEE 1633-2016 software reliability activities framework, offering a holistic review of current AI software reliability studies. Starting with a foundational understanding, the subsequent sections delve into extant reliability frameworks such as IEEE 1633-2016, followed by an exploration into AI-specific considerations in reliability planning, failure mode modeling, reliability application in development and testing phases, support for release decisions, and post-deployment monitoring. The study underscores the paramount importance of pioneering and adopting AI-specific reliability engineering practices.

articleTitle: Dynamic event-triggered mechanism-based resilient H∞ state estimation for neural networks with random parameters and time delays
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The resilient H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> state estimation problem is investigated in this paper for a kind of neural networks with random parameters and time delays based on a dynamic event-triggered mechanism, which is employed for the purpose of reducing energy consumption. Under the action of the dynamic event-triggered mechanism, the measurement output is transmitted to the corresponding state estimator only when a certain triggering condition is met. The aim of this paper is to design a resilient state estimator for the delayed neural networks with random parameters such that the dynamics of estimation error system is asymptotically mean-square stable with the specified H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance requirement. We derive a sufficient condition by using the Lyapunov theory, which guarantees that the estimation error system is asymptotically mean-the given H∞ performance constraint. Then, the gain matrix of the designed state estimator is presented by means of solving a set of linear matrix inequalities. A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed state estimator.
